title: Original Sin
definition: Original sin is the doctrine that all humanity is affected by Adam’s fall, inheriting a sinful condition and standing in need of salvation from birth.
summary: Human beings do not become sinners only by outward acts; we commit sins because the heart is already fallen. This doctrine explains the depth of humanity’s need for grace.
christFocus: Christ, the last Adam, succeeds where Adam failed. Through Him, grace reigns over sin and death for all who belong to Him by faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Adam’s sin brought death and corruption into the human race.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Original sin shows why every person needs new birth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Christ’s obedience and righteousness are the believer’s hope.
